review_notes: Segment 0: The phrase 'कैर्मयास हि योद्धव्यम् अस्मिन् रणसमुद्यमे' appears to be a misrecognition or nonstandard transcription of a Sanskrit line; its intended canonical wording is unclear. Preserved as spoken — please review for accuracy.

Segment 0: The segment ends with the fragment 'संद' in the raw transcript (cut-off). The fragment was preserved as in source; please check the original audio to confirm whether it should be 'संदेह' or another word.

Segment 2: The phrase 'विषीदन्निदमब्रवीत' appears to be a Sanskrit quotation (likely from Bhagavadgītā). Its spacing and exact diacritics were preserved from the raw transcript; please verify the canonical wording if an exact shloka transcription is required.

Segment 3: Several Sanskrit / quoted phrases appear to be imperfectly transcribed and may need human verification against canonical sources before any correction: 'अहो बत महत् पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम्।', 'विसृज्य सशरं चापम्।', 'रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्।', and 'वंचितो हम् महाराज हरिणा बन्धुरूपिणा।'.
Segment 3: Consider verifying whether 'भागवत में' should be 'भगवद्गीता में' (speaker likely referring to the Gita).

Segment 4: Sanskrit fragments (e.g., 'येनोपहृतं तेजः, तेजं दैवविस्मापनम् महत्') were left largely as in the raw transcript because the intended original wording is uncertain; only minimal, high-confidence corrections were applied.
Segment 4: Preserved English code-switching (e.g., 'as a property', 'He can be the highest class of professional') as in the original.
Segment 4: Avoided substantive rewrites; edits focused on high-confidence ASR fixes, punctuation, and small grammatical clarifications.

Segment 5: The phrase around 'दिव्यास्त्र' and the following clause in the original ('कोई-कोई लोग के पास दिव्यास्त्र ही छोड़ने ही नहीं आता, बटन ही नहीं दबाने रहता, कैसे चेक करें?') was unclear. I corrected 'लोग के' → 'लोगों के' and replaced the garbled fragment with 'दिव्यास्त्र ही... बटन दबाना नहीं आता' but this substitution is medium-confidence and should be reviewed against the audio.
Segment 5: The word 'सबरी' (in 'कोई सबरी बनता है') remains as in the original; its intended word was not clear from the transcript and should be checked in the source audio.

Segment 6: Consider verifying the phrase 'स्वरूपावस्थान' ("स्वरूपावस्थान के लिए काम करता हूँ") — it may be a mis-transcription or a compound phrase unclear from the raw audio. No change was made due to uncertainty.

Segment 7: Phrase 'सम्यक् जजम् कृतं येन सः संजयः' in the explanation appears garbled (likely an etymological gloss). I preserved the raw wording because corrections could change doctrinal meaning; please review and, if needed, supply the intended phrasing (e.g., the etymological explanation of 'संजय').

Segment 8: The opening phrase 'तत्त्व बोलना नहीं जानते थे' may be an ASR error (possible alternatives: 'सत्य बोलना...' or 'तथ्य बोलना...') — left unchanged due to uncertainty; please verify against audio.

Segment 8: The fragment 'कृपया परया विष्टः।' remains unclear and appears garbled; context suggests discussion of 'कृपयाविष्टम्' and forms of 'विष्टः/विष्टम्' — please review that short passage against the recording.

Segment 8: I normalized several Sanskrit segments to a standardized form where the intended wording was clear from context. If a verbatim rendering of the speaker's exact utterance (including hesitations or nonstandard forms) is required, recheck those Sanskrit corrections.

Segment 9: The Bhagavadgītā quotations (approx. 2.2–2.3) were normalized and segmented into standard Devanagari śloka lines because the speaker's recitation made the intended verses clear. If a different edition/orthography is preferred, please review these lines.

Segment 10: Left 'परसी करते हैं' unchanged — ASR produced 'परसी', which is unusual in this context; uncertain whether speaker said 'परख/परखते हैं' or another word. Human review advised if fidelity to original utterance is required.
